name: Bathyal-Shoal
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by asteroid belt proximity. Beyond orbital debris ring, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
research outpost was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
